The '''Hollow Moon''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] world located in the [[Khorya system/Legends|Khorya system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

==History==
The Hollow Moon was largely controlled by an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] gangster named [[Sollima]]. It hosted all type of gambling&mdash;from [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tables to the gladiator rings. The [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] wanted a piece of it for years but did not want to start a large-scale conflict in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. So they first stole Sollima's accounting droid to used information inside him against Sollima and later ordered [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Billal Batross]] to infiltrate the Moon and disable its security network in exchange for release from captivity. Once they completed the task, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took control over the world.
